hero.subtitle: This policy explains how GYDI uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our platform.

intro.title: Why do we use Cookies?
intro.text: Cookies help us provide, protect, and improve GYDI. They allow us to remember your preferences, understand how you use our platform, personalize your experience, and track affiliate referrals to ensure fair payments.

s1.title: 1. What are Cookies?
s1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. They allow the website to "remember" your actions and preferences for a period of time.
s1.techText: In addition to cookies, we use similar technologies such as web beacons (tracking pixels), localStorage, sessionStorage, and mobile SDKs. This policy applies to all these technologies.

s2.title: 2. Types of Cookies
s2.sessionText: Temporary. Deleted when you close your browser. Essential for navigating the site.
s2.persistentText: Remain on your device for a specific period (days, months, years) or until you delete them manually. Used to remember preferences and track referrals.
s2.firstPartyText: Set directly by GYDI. We completely control how this data is used.
s2.thirdPartyText: Set by external services (Google Analytics, Stripe, etc.). Check their privacy policies for more information.

s3.title: 3. Cookies We Use
s3.necessaryDesc: Essential for the basic functioning of the site. Without these cookies, the platform cannot function properly.
s3.functionalDesc: Allow us to remember your choices (language, currency, preferences) to provide a personalized experience.
s3.referral_id_purpose: Track the affiliate link that brought you
s3.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors use GYDI, which pages are most popular, and how to improve the site.
s3.marketingDesc: Used to display relevant ads and measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

s4.title: 4. How to Manage Cookies
s4.step1Text: Use the cookie banner when visiting the site or access Settings → Privacy in your account.
s4.step2Text: All browsers allow you to manage cookies:
s4.warningText: If you block or delete cookies, some GYDI features may not work properly:
s4.w1: You won't be able to stay logged in
s4.w2: Your preferences (language, currency) won't be saved
s4.w3: Affiliate referrals may not be tracked correctly
s4.w4: The user experience will be less personalized

s5.title: 5. Do Not Track (DNT)
s5.text: Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" (DNT) signal. Currently, there is no industry standard on how to respond to DNT. GYDI does not respond to DNT signals, but you can manage cookies through the options described above.

s6.title: 6. Affiliate Cookies
s6.highlight: Affiliate tracking cookies are essential to our business model.
s6.p1Pre: When you click an affiliate link, we set a cookie (
s6.p1Post: ) that lasts 30 days. If you make a purchase or booking within that period, the affiliate receives their commission.
s6.importantText: If your referrals block cookies, they may not be tracked correctly and you could lose commissions. We recommend including a notice in your promotions informing users that cookies are necessary to track referrals.

s7.title: 7. Changes to this Policy
s7.intro: We may update this policy occasionally to reflect changes in our cookie practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes via:
s7.n2: Updated cookie banner on your next visit
